set.body:
Outcome
Demonstrate the design in a real scientific workflow without conflating theme and runtime migration.

Owned scope
chosen application's explicitly owned integration paths; consumer receipt in Meridian

Prerequisites
D0, C4, C5, D3

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Implement under the chosen application's own issue/reservations and exact pinned Meridian/ScalaDock candidates; keep changes limited to authorized theme/composition integration.
- [ ] Exercise a real representative viewport plus table/editing/validation and save/restore/popout workflows in all four variants.
- [ ] Run the application's existing rendering and scientific invariant gates on the chosen runtime; record main/float focus, overlays, scientific state/export and zero appearance-triggered analysis.
- [ ] Confirm an application-level rollback to its previous appearance/dependency pins and preserve existing saved-layout/domain data.
- [ ] Record provider/consumer SHA and artifact parity and owner review. A passing sampler alone cannot close this task.

Required evidence
Application-owned implementation/review receipt, exact pins, native captures and relevant existing application gate logs.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code D5. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [D5] Integrate and qualify the chosen real application
